findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 11 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 17 questions numbered 1-17; by section: 11.1 6, 11.2 5, 11.3 1, 11.4 3, 11.5 2.

Covers position of the heart and pericardium, chambers and septa, cardiac cycle with heart sounds, heart-rate control and artificial pacemaker, ECG waves, blue babies, capillary exchange, vasodilation in active tissues, velocity of flow and venous return, hepatic portal system, pulmonary versus systemic circulation, hormonal regulation of blood pressure, angiography, effects of hypertension, thrombosis, lymphatic functions, lacteals and lymph nodes. Topics asked by the chapter exercise's long questions are approached from other angles. Book correction followed: first-degree heart block is a prolonged PR interval.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
